justification: Both surfaces show schematic outline imagery with multiple animal-like figures, including at least one bird- or long-necked creature and curving wing/appendage forms. The biggest difference is that B is organized into clear horizontal registers with repeated top motifs, a patterned band, and distinct animals below, whereas A appears as a more diffuse, crowded field of interlaced figures without the same register structure or the same specific set of motifs.
